'''Enchant Crossbow Bolt (Pearl)''' is a [[Enchant Crossbow Bolt|bolt enchantment spell]] that requires a [[Magic]] level of 24 to cast. It imbues 10 [[pearl bolts]] each cast and turns them into 10 [[pearl bolts (e)]] or 10 [[pearl dragon bolts]] into 10 [[pearl dragon bolts (e)]]. The enchantment gives the effect ''Sea Curse''. Each bolt has a small chance of causing extra water damage towards your enemy. When used towards a fire-type monster or a player with fiery equipment, it can hit much greater damage. The effect is fully negated when used against a player holding a [[staff of water]] or any of its stronger counterparts.
